title: U-Statistics-Powered LLM Reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2611.33064v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Since its introduction by DeepSeek, group relative policy optimization (GRPO) has been widely adopted for training large reasoning models and agents, spurring a proliferation of its variants. Yet the group size, a crucial hyperparameter in these GRPO-type algorithms, remains largely chosen by trial and error. Exploiting the U-statistic structure of GRPO's policy gradient, we recast the selection of the group size as a classical statistical problem of variance ratio estimation. This problem is particularly challenging when the denominator of the ratio is small, rendering naive plug-in estimators unstable. To address this challenge, we propose a pessimistic ratio estimator that accounts for the denominator's estimation uncertainty. We characterise the statistical properties of this estimator across three sample-size regimes. translated_title: 基于 U 统计量的大语言模型推理
translated_abstract: 自 DeepSeek 提出组相对策略优化（GRPO）以来，该方法已被广泛用于训练大型推理模型和智能体，并催生了众多变体。然而，组大小作为这类 GRPO 型算法中的一个关键超参数，目前仍在很大程度上依靠反复试错来选择。本文利用 GRPO 策略梯度的 U 统计量结构，将组大小的选择重新表述为一个经典的统计问题——方差比估计。当分母较小时，该问题尤其具有挑战性，导致朴素的代入估计量不稳定。为应对这一挑战，我们提出了一种考虑分母估计不确定性的悲观比率估计量，并刻画了该估计量在三种样本量情形下的统计性质。实证方面，我们在来自 Reasoning Gym 的合成任务和真实世界基准上采用了基于 jackknife 的悲观规则（原文在此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文利用 GRPO 策略梯度的 U 统计量结构，将组大小选择转化为方差比估计这一经典统计问题，并提出考虑分母估计不确定性的悲观比率估计量，从而以系统且稳定的方式确定这一关键超参数。
en_tdlr: This paper exploits the U-statistic structure of GRPO's policy gradient to recast group-size selection as a classical variance ratio estimation problem, and proposes a pessimistic ratio estimator that accounts for denominator estimation uncertainty, enabling a systematic and stable determination of this crucial hyperparameter.
